title: Swedish Charles XII Bible (Karl XII:s bibel, 1703), one verse per line
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/sv/SweKarlXII/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module SweKarlXII). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 3,108,585 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'swedish') gives 2,671,239 characters.
